overview.description: The Munificent Seven ETF (BBLS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in energy equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that primarily invests in seven global energy companies that are expected to benefit from the AI ecosystem. The fund focuses on the growing demand for electricity generation, industrial infrastructure, energy production, physical resource development, and capital goods investments. BBLS was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
